name: Storming Grasp
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

Targets one creature/level touched
Duration 1 min./level (D)

This spell functions as shocking grasp except you can make one touch per caster level within the duration.

Each touch is a separate standard action. This touch attack can be delivered as part of spell combat and spellstrike without needing to cast the spell.
